projects.name: Floppy Birb
projects.title: Hobby Game
projects.short_description: Small Flappy Bird clone made in under 24 hours.
projects.description: Floppy Birb is a small Flappy Bird clone made in under 24 hours. It features simple graphics and addictive gameplay, where players control a bird trying to navigate through a series of pipes without crashing. The game is designed to be easy to pick up but challenging to master, providing endless fun for players of all ages.
highlights: Created in under 24 hours as a game jam project.
Designed to be accessible for players of all skill levels.

projects.name: Escape Protocol VR
projects.title: Games and Simulated Environments Course
projects.short_description: Asymmetric Cooperative Game. The VR player must cooperate with its hacker companion (PC player) to solve challenges, find the USB killers and escape.
projects.description: During an infiltration mission into an AI, one agent falls into a trap and becomes trapped inside its network. In response, the AI activates its defenses. Outside, a hacker monitoring the mission detects the breach and opens a communication channel with the agent. The two now must work together, one inside and one outside, to bypass defenses and find an escape route before the AI eliminates the agent.
highlights: Asymmetric gameplay, allowing for two distinct experiences within the same bundle.
The game runs on a wide variety of VR headsets, as long as they have PCVR functionality.
Focus on communication and teamwork, creating tense and memorable cooperative moments.

projects.name: Narcissa
projects.title: Languages and Programming Environments Course
projects.short_description: Snake game variant developed to learn JavaScript.
projects.description: Snake game variant developed to learn JavaScript. The player controls a snake that grows in size as it eats food, but must avoid colliding with itself or the walls. The game ends when the snake collides with itself or the bushes that keep growing, and the player's score is based on how long they survive and how much food they eat. The player also needs to control which color of food they eat.
highlights: Interesting gameplay variations such as growing bushes and different colors of food that the player must eat.
